title: UI / UX DESIGN Intern
description:
**Job Title: UI/UX Intern (3 months) with a passion for sustainability**

Job Summary:

We are seeking a UI/UX Intern with a passion for sustainability to join our team for a 3-month internship. As a UI/UX Intern, you will be responsible for creating visually appealing, user-friendly, and sustainable designs for our web and mobile applications. You will work closely with our development team to ensure that the designs you create are implemented successfully.

Responsibilities:

* Work with the development team to understand project requirements and user needs
* Create user-friendly and visually appealing designs for web and mobile applications
* Conduct user research and usability testing to ensure designs meet user needs
* Create wireframes, prototypes, and design mockups
* Collaborate with the development team to ensure designs are implemented successfully
* Stay up to date with industry trends and design standards
* Work on special projects related to sustainability initiatives

Qualifications:

* Strong passion for sustainability and environmental issues
* A portfolio demonstrating experience in UI/UX design
* Familiarity with design tools such as Sketch, Adobe XD, Figma, or InVision
* Ability to work collaboratively with a team and take feedback constructively
* Excellent communication skills
* Strong attention to detail and ability to multitask
* Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in UI/UX design, graphic design, or a related field
* Knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript is a plus

Salary:

This is a paid internship with a monthly salary of 4000 Rs.

If you are passionate about sustainability and have experience in UI/UX design, we encourage you to apply. This internship will provide you with hands-on experience in designing sustainable applications while working with a supportive team.
